purpose: Answer key for the synthetic 'paper leak' demo case. Written by hand alongside the chat exports so a future contradiction detector (roadmap Phase 6) can be evaluated: every planted contradiction and every innocent decoy is listed with the exact timestamp, sender and quote. test_leak_case.py checks each reference really exists in the sample files.

cast.Yash: SUSPECT. Warm, generous, over-helpful ('bhai', 'I got you', 'no stress'). Pays for everyone, shares notes. Adds detail and jokes when cornered; tells each person a different story.
cast.Meenakshi: Topper. Formal, exact times and dates, quotes people's earlier messages back at them. Never accuses, only 'points out inconsistencies'.
cast.Tanvi: Gossip, drama, emoji-heavy. Unreliable witness: mixes up days.
cast.Harshit: Class clown, all lowercase, Yash's loyal best friend. Defends him until the end.
cast.Sana: Quiet scholarship student who owes Yash fee money. Saw him at the shop but first wrote 'at home'.
cast.Parth: Gym-bro. Secretly bought OS+CN papers. Publicly says he only used the 'guess list'.
cast.Nikhil: Class rep. Formal notices signed 'Regards, Nikhil'. Investigates quietly.
cast.Kritika: Yash's girlfriend, design student. Her 9:12 pm Instagram story puts him at the shop.
cast.Arjun: Yash's hostel roommate. Deadpan, terse, exact times. Silent in the group, key witness in DMs.

similarity_traps: Yash, Harshit and Parth all use 'bro/bhai' and 'lol'-style slang
Meenakshi and Nikhil are both formal and time-precise
Tanvi and Kritika are both emoji-heavy and expressive
Sana and Arjun both write very short messages

ground_truth.summary: Yash works weekend evenings at Sharma Xerox (near Gate 2), which the exam cell used to print the DBMS, CN and OS mid-sem papers; the SE paper was printed in the department. On Sat 20 Sep 2025 he photographed the master papers, and sold them through a Telegram channel ('ImpQs Official', admin @lalit_impqs, ~312 members, ~3-5k per pack) with payments collected under the alias/account 'Lalit'. He circulated a 'guess list' to the class as cover. The channel has run since at least last semester.

timeline_2025.Sat 20 Sep 8:34 pm: signs out of hostel (gate register), tells everyone he is on DND from 9 and studying
timeline_2025.Sat 20 Sep ~9:12 pm: seen entering Sharma Xerox in the background of Kritika's story
timeline_2025.Sat 20 Sep ~10:30 pm: seen inside the shop with keys on a red lanyard by Sana
timeline_2025.Sun 21 Sep 12:20 am: replies in the group despite 'DND' and 'asleep by 11'
timeline_2025.Sun 21 Sep 1:52 am: signs back into hostel; works on laptop until about 3
timeline_2025.Sun 21 Sep 9:05 am: posts the 'guess list' (matches 17/20 DBMS, 16/20 CN, 15/20 OS)
timeline_2025.Mon-Wed 22-24 Sep: DBMS, CN, OS papers match the list; SE (no list) does not
timeline_2025.Mon 6 Oct: exam-cell notice; Yash names subjects and a count the notice never gave
timeline_2025.Thu 13 Nov: Parth confesses; Yash reveals he knows the payee is 'Lalit'
timeline_2025.Fri 14 Nov: Sana tells the group what she saw; Yash's explanation changes again
timeline_2025.Mon 17 Nov: police and cyber cell ask all students to report with phones
